mapper.sql: id, owner_type, owner_id, leader_member_id, invite_code, title, join_mode, max_members, joined_count, status, expire_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select from play_team where id = #{id} for update
mapper.insert: insert into play_team (owner_type, owner_id, leader_member_id, invite_code, title, join_mode, max_members, joined_count, status, expire_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{ownerType}, #{ownerId}, #{leaderMemberId}, #{inviteCode}, #{title}, #{joinMode}, #{maxMembers}, #{joinedCount}, #{status}, #{expireTime}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update play_team set join_mode = #{joinMode}, update_time = now() where id = #{teamId} and leader_member_id = #{leaderMemberId}
mapper.insert: insert into play_team_member (team_id, member_id, role, status, apply_message, apply_expire_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{teamId}, #{memberId}, #{role}, #{status}, #{applyMessage}, #{applyExpireTime}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update play_team_member set status = 1, role = 0, apply_message = null, apply_expire_time = null, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and member_id = #{memberId} and status in (0, 2, 5, 6)
mapper.select: select id, team_id, member_id, role, status, apply_message, apply_expire_time, create_time, update_time from play_team_member where team_id = #{teamId} and member_id = #{memberId} limit 1
mapper.update: update play_team_member set status = 0, role = 0, apply_message = #{applyMessage}, apply_expire_time = #{applyExpireTime}, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and member_id = #{memberId} and status = #{fromStatus}
update play_team_member set status = 1, apply_expire_time = null, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and member_id = #{memberId} and status = 0 and apply_expire_time > #{now}
update play_team_member set status = 4, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and member_id = #{memberId} and status = 0 and apply_expire_time > #{now}
update play_team_member set status = 6, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and status = 0
update play_team_member set status = 6, update_time = now() where status = 0 and apply_expire_time <= #{now}
update play_team set join_mode = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{teamId} and join_mode = 2
mapper.select: select count(1) from audit_task where biz_type = 'TEAM' and biz_id = #{teamId} and status in (0, 3)

select count(distinct m.member_id) from play_team_member m join play_team t on t.id = m.team_id join cms_registration r on r.member_id = m.member_id and r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = t.owner_id and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 where m.team_id = #{teamId} and m.status = 1

select m.id, m.team_id, m.member_id, m.role, m.status, m.apply_message, m.apply_expire_time, m.create_time, m.update_time, u.nickname as member_name, u.avatar as member_avatar from play_team_member m left join ums_member u on u.id = m.member_id where m.team_id = #{teamId} and m.status = 0 and m.apply_expire_time > #{now} order by m.update_time asc, m.id asc

select t.id as teamId, t.title as title, t.owner_id as activityId, a.name as activityName, a.start_date as startDate, leader.nickname as leaderName, t.joined_count as joinedCount, t.max_members as maxMembers, t.status as teamStatus, case when m.status = 0 then 'PENDING' else 'REJECTED' end as applyStatus, m.apply_expire_time as applyExpireTime, m.update_time as appliedAt from play_team_member m join play_team t on t.id = m.team_id left join cms_activity a on t.owner_type = 2 and a.id = t.owner_id left join ums_member leader on leader.id = t.leader_member_id where m.member_id = #{memberId} and t.status in (0, 1) and ((m.status = 0 and m.apply_expire_time > #{now}) or m.status = 4) order by m.update_time desc, m.id desc

select m.id, m.team_id, m.member_id, m.role, m.status, m.apply_message, m.apply_expire_time, m.create_time, m.update_time, u.nickname as member_name, u.avatar as member_avatar from play_team_member m left join ums_member u on u.id = m.member_id where m.team_id = #{teamId} and m.member_id = #{memberId} and m.status = 1 limit 1

select m.id, m.team_id, m.member_id, m.role, m.status, m.apply_message, m.apply_expire_time, m.create_time, m.update_time, u.nickname as member_name, u.avatar as member_avatar from play_team_member m left join ums_member u on u.id = m.member_id where m.team_id = #{teamId} and m.member_id <> #{memberId} and m.status = 1 order by m.create_time asc, m.id asc limit 1

select m.id, m.team_id, m.member_id, m.role, m.status, m.apply_message, m.apply_expire_time, m.create_time, m.update_time, u.nickname as member_name, u.avatar as member_avatar from play_team_member m left join ums_member u on u.id = m.member_id where m.team_id = #{teamId} and m.status = 1 order by m.role desc, m.create_time asc, m.id asc
select count(1) from play_team_member where team_id = #{teamId} and status = 1
mapper.update: update play_team set joined_count = joined_count + 1, status = if(joined_count >= max_members, 1, status), update_time = now() where id = #{teamId} and joined_count < max_members and status = 0
update play_team set joined_count = joined_count - 1, status = if(status = 1, 0, status), update_time = now() where id = #{teamId} and joined_count > 0 and status in (0, 1)
update play_team set leader_member_id = #{newLeaderId}, update_time = now() where id = #{teamId} and leader_member_id = #{oldLeaderId} and status in (0, 1)
update play_team set status = 4, joined_count = 0, update_time = now() where id = #{teamId} and leader_member_id = #{leaderMemberId} and status in (0, 1)
update play_team_member set status = 2, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and status = 1
mapper.select: select count(1) from cms_registration r left join cms_activity a on r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = a.id and a.del_flag = 0 where r.member_id = #{memberId} and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 and ( (#{ownerType} = 2 and r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = #{ownerId}) or (#{ownerType} = 1 and ( (r.owner_type = 1 and r.owner_id = #{ownerId}) or (r.owner_type = 2 and a.topic_id = #{ownerId}) )) )

select r.member_id as memberId, m.nickname as nickname, m.avatar as avatar, (select t.id from play_team t join play_team_member tm on tm.team_id = t.id and tm.member_id = r.member_id and tm.status = 1 where t.owner_type = 2 and t.owner_id = #{activityId} and t.status in (0, 1, 2) order by t.id asc limit 1) as teamId, (select t.title from play_team t join play_team_member tm on tm.team_id = t.id and tm.member_id = r.member_id and tm.status = 1 where t.owner_type = 2 and t.owner_id = #{activityId} and t.status in (0, 1, 2) order by t.id asc limit 1) as teamTitle, (select count(distinct p.node_id) from player_node_progress p where p.member_id = r.member_id and p.activity_id = #{activityId} and p.status = 1 and p.del_flag = 0) as done from cms_registration r join ums_member m on m.id = r.member_id where r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = #{activityId} and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 and r.member_id in #{id} group by r.member_id, m.nickname, m.avatar

select t.id, t.owner_type, t.owner_id, t.leader_member_id, t.invite_code, t.title, t.join_mode, t.max_members, t.joined_count, t.status, t.expire_time, t.create_time, t.update_time from play_team t join play_team_member m on m.team_id = t.id and m.member_id = #{memberId} and m.status = 1 order by t.status asc, t.create_time desc

select t.id from play_team t left join cms_activity activity on t.owner_type = 2 and activity.id = t.owner_id left join cms_topic topic on topic.id = activity.topic_id left join game_session game on t.owner_type = 2 and game.activity_id = t.owner_id where t.status in (0, 1) and t.expire_time is not null and t.expire_time <= #{now} and ( (game.id is null and topic.game_module_config_json is null) or activity.end_date <= #{now} ) order by t.expire_time asc, t.id asc limit #{limit}
